query:
insert into TestRunLineCoverage (
                        latest_collection,
                        product_id,
                        test_run_name,
                        cov_filepath,
                        cov_file_hash,
                        cov_line,
                        hits
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4,
                        $5,
                        $6,
                        $7
                    )
                    on conflict (
                        product_id,
                        test_run_name,
                        cov_filepath,
                        cov_line
                    ) do update
                    set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                        cov_file_hash = excluded.cov_file_hash,
                        hits = excluded.hits
